info.name: GameVault
info.description:
## Kguysh GameVault BackendAPI

The Backend API for **Kguysh GameVault** — a platform for purchasing digital game activation keys.  
  
It powers the core functionality of the GameVault system, including authentication, user roles, ticket-based customer support, and game/inventory management.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to fetch details of a specific game by its ID from the backend API.

### Retrieve Game Details by Name

#### Description

This endpoint is used to fetch details of a specific game by its name from the backend API.

#### Request

- **Request Path**: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/games/search/name`
    
- **Method**: `GET`
    

#### Query Parameters

- `search_query` (string, required): The name of the game to search for.
    

#### Response

The response for this request can be documented as a JSON schema:

### Retrieve Multiple Games Details

This endpoint is used to retrieve details of specific games by their IDs from the backend API.

#### Request Path

`GET` /api/v1/games/get/multi

#### Query Parameters

    - `slug` (string): Genre slug.
        
    - `updated_at` (number): Timestamp of last update.
        
    - `url` (string): URL of the genre.
        
    - `checksum` (string): Checksum value.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve videos for the specified game IDs. The request should include the IDs of the games for which the videos are to be fetched.

### Request

- Method: GET
    
- Endpoint: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/games/get/videos`
    
- Query Parameters:
    
    - ids (required): Comma-separated list of game IDs for which videos are to be retrieved.
        

### Response

Upon a successful execution, the endpoint returns a JSON response with a 200 status code and the following structure:

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "queryResult": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "game": 0,
      "name": "",
      "video_id": "",
      "checksum": ""
    }
  ]
}

 ```

The `queryResult` array contains the video details for the requested game IDs. Each object in the array includes the video's ID, associated game ID, name, video ID, and checksum.

### **api/v1/store/games/search**

This API endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to search for games in the store based on the provided query parameter. The request URL is `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/store/games/search`, and it includes a query parameter `q` with the value "among us".

### Request Body

This request does not contain a request body.

### Response Body

The response to this request is in JSON format with a status code of 200. It includes a `success` key with a boolean value, and a `games` array containing information about the games found based on the search query. Each game object in the array includes various properties such as `id`, `name`, `summary`, `category`, `cover_url`, `price`, `copies`, and other details related to the game.

Example Response:

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "games": [
    {
      "_id": "",
      "id": 0,
      "name": "",
      "slug": "",
      "summary": "",
      "storyline": "",
      "category": 0,
      "game_type": 0,
      "cover_url": "",
      "price": 0,
      "copies": 0,
      "createdAt": "",
      "__v": 0,
      "isFeatured": true
    }
  ]
}

 ```

request.description:
This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve all games from the store based on a specific theme and with a limit on the number of games to be returned.

### Request

- Method: GET
    
- URL: [http://localhost:3000/api/v1/store/games/get-all](http://localhost:3000/api/v1/store/games/get-all)
    
- Query Parameters:
    
    - theme (number): The theme ID for filtering the games.
        
    - limit (number): The maximum number of games to be returned.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve all games from the store. The request includes query parameters for sorting by "hypes" and limiting the result to 1 game.

### Request Body

This request does not include a request body.

### Response Body

The response is in JSON format and includes a "success" flag along with an array of "games" containing detailed information about each game. Each game object includes various attributes such as ID, name, summary, category, release date, cover image URL, price, and more. Additionally, the response includes metadata such as "total" number of games, current "page", and total "pages" available.

### Example

``` json
{
    "success": true,
    "games": [
        {
            "_id": "",
            "id": 0,
            "name": "",
            "slug": "",
            "summary": "",
            "category": 0,
            "game_type": 0,
            "first_release_date": 0,

            // ... (other game attributes)
        }
    ],
    "total": 0,
    "page": 0,
    "pages": 0
}

 ```

### Store Set Discount

This endpoint allows you to set a discount for a specific game in the store.

#### Request Body

- `gameId` (string) - The ID of the game for which the discount is being set.
    
- `discount` (number) - The discount percentage to be set for the game.
    

#### Response

- Status: 403/200/400
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    

The response will include an empty `status` field and an `error` object with `statusCode`, `status`, `isOperational`, `message`, and `stack` fields.

#### Request Body

- `userId` (string): The ID of the user.

    - `_id` (string): The ID of the wishlist.

    - `games` (array): An array of objects containing details of the games in the wishlist.
        
        - `gameId` (string): The ID of the game.
            
        - `_id` (string): The ID of the wishlist item.
            
        - `addedAt` (string): Timestamp of when the game was added to the wishlist.
            
    - `createdAt` (string): Timestamp of the creation of the wishlist.
        
    - `updatedAt` (string): Timestamp of the last update to the wishlist.
        
    - `__v` (number): Version control field.

### Remove Item from Wishlist

This endpoint allows the user to remove a game from their wishlist.

#### Request Body

- userId (string, required): The unique identifier of the user.
    
- gameId (string, required): The unique identifier of the game to be removed from the wishlist.

The response will be a JSON object with the following properties:

    - userId (string): The unique identifier of the user.
        
    - games (array): An array of games in the wishlist.
        
    - createdAt (string): The timestamp of the creation of the wishlist.
        
    - updatedAt (string): The timestamp of the last update to the wishlist.
        
    - __v (number): Version control field.

{

  }

#### Request Body

{

``` json
{

  "status": "string",
  "_id": "string",
  "replies": [],
  "createdAt": "string",
  "updatedAt": "string",

}

 ```

The `userId` represents the user associated with the ticket, `subject` and `message` contain the details of the ticket, `status` indicates the current status of the ticket, `_id` is the unique identifier for the ticket, `replies` contains any replies associated with the ticket, `createdAt` and `updatedAt` represent the creation and last update timestamps, and `__v` is the version key.

  "status": "string",

### Create Promo

The `Create Promo` endpoint allows you to create a new promotional code with specific discount and usage conditions.

#### Request Body

- `code` (string) - The unique code for the promotional offer.
    
- `discountType` (string) - The type of discount, e.g. "percentage" or "fixed".
    
- `discountValue` (number) - The value of the discount.
    
- `expiryDate` (string) - The date and time when the promotional offer expires.
    
- `maxUses` (number) - The maximum number of times the promotional code can be used.
    
- `minimumPurchase` (number) - The minimum purchase amount required to use the promotional code.
    
- `description` (string) - A brief description of the promotional offer.
    

#### Response (201 - Created)

The response will be in JSON format with the following schema:

``` json
{
    "message": "",
    "status": true,
    "promo": {
        "code": "",
        "discountType": "",
        "discountValue": 0,
        "maxUses": 0,
        "usedCount": 0,
        "expiryDate": "",
        "isActive": true,
        "description": "",
        "minimumPurchase": 0,
        "_id": "",
        "createdAt": "",
        "updatedAt": "",
        "usedBy": [],
        "__v": 0
    }
}

 ```

- `message` (string) - A message related to the response.
    
- `status` (boolean) - Indicates the status of the operation.
    
- `promo` (object) - Details of the created promotional offer.
    
    - `code` (string) - The unique code for the promotional offer.
        
    - `discountType` (string) - The type of discount, e.g. "percentage" or "fixed".
        
    - `discountValue` (number) - The value of the discount.
        
    - `maxUses` (number) - The maximum number of times the promotional code can be used.
        
    - `usedCount` (number) - The number of times the promotional code has been used.
        
    - `expiryDate` (string) - The date and time when the promotional offer expires.
        
    - `isActive` (boolean) - Indicates if the promotional offer is active.
        
    - `description` (string) - A brief description of the promotional offer.
        
    - `minimumPurchase` (number) - The minimum purchase amount required to use the promotional code.
        
    - `_id` (string) - The unique identifier of the promotional offer.
        
    - `createdAt` (string) - The date and time when the promotional offer was created.
        
    - `updatedAt` (string) - The date and time when the promotional offer was last updated.
        
    - `usedBy` (array) - An array of users who have used the promotional code.
        
    - `__v` (number) - Version key.
